mapper.sql: user_id, provider, provider_user_id, login_id, email, display_name, nickname, contact_number, profile_image_url, status, terms_agreed_at, created_at, updated_at, last_login_at, approved_at, approved_by, withdrawn_at, withdrawal_reason
mapper.select: select count(*) from app_user where status = #{status}
mapper.insert: insert into app_user ( provider, provider_user_id, login_id, email, display_name, nickname, contact_number, profile_image_url, status, terms_agreed_at, created_at, updated_at, last_login_at, approved_at, approved_by, withdrawn_at, withdrawal_reason ) values ( #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{loginId}, #{email}, #{displayName}, #{nickname}, #{contactNumber}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{status}, #{termsAgreedAt}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp, current_timestamp, #{approvedAt}, #{approvedBy}, #{withdrawnAt}, #{withdrawalReason} )
mapper.update: update app_user set email = #{email}, display_name = #{displayName}, nickname = #{nickname}, profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, updated_at = current_timestamp, last_login_at = current_timestamp where user_id = #{id}

update app_user set login_id = #{loginId}, display_name = #{displayName}, contact_number = #{contactNumber}, terms_agreed_at = #{termsAgreedAt}, status = #{status}, updated_at = current_timestamp where user_id = #{id}

update app_user set status = #{status}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_at = case when #{status} = 'ACTIVE' then current_timestamp else null end, withdrawn_at = case when #{status} = 'WITHDRAWN' then current_timestamp else null end, withdrawal_reason = #{withdrawalReason}, updated_at = current_timestamp where user_id = #{id}
